active_inquiry.closure_condition: Close when a learned candidate has episode-level development evidence covering the official radius-angle distribution with first-reach, maximum-held-steps, hold interruptions, and geometry-stratified outcomes sufficient to classify the dominant failure mode as reach-limited, stabilization-limited, geometry-conditioned, or inconclusive.
active_inquiry.goal_connection: The campaign needs at least 196 of 200 episodes to complete an uninterrupted 100-step hold. This inquiry determines whether the next intervention should improve global trajectory generation and geometry coverage or terminal stabilization after reach.
active_inquiry.handoff_conclusion: Evidence: M1 compiled the authored MuJoCo model at 2 ms physics and 20 ms control intervals, with nonzero compiled body masses, 0.5 joint damping, 0.01 armature, gear-5 bounded motors, and the documented joint limits. Across 240 radius-angle/branch configurations, 224 were within joint limits and none of those valid configurations had active contacts; this removes folded-link self-contact as the leading explanation on the sampled official geometry, while retaining branch and limit conditioning as a reach concern. Across 1,344 matched near-target rollouts, both zero input and bounded local PD completed all 100-step holds for all three position/velocity perturbation classes, with mean maximum distances of about 1.65 mm and 1.41 mm respectively. Interpretation: the tested plant has more than enough local passive/active stabilization margin for the 1 cm sampled tolerance, so hold failure is not currently the most credible first bottleneck. The reset singularity, target-angle coverage, and joint-limit-valid branch selection remain untested at the learned-policy level; M1 does not prove that a policy can reach globally, and its local perturbations do not represent high-speed arrival from reset. The competing explanation that learned exploration/reward alignment, rather than plant authority, limits success is now the decision-relevant alternative.
active_inquiry.handoff_question: Can a first learned policy reliably reach and settle into valid target postures from the exact extended reset across the full official radius-angle distribution, or do failures concentrate in reset-opposed or joint-limit-conditioned geometry despite the demonstrated local hold margin?
